name: Immersion Corporation
summary: Immersion Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the business of intellectual property (IP) that engages user sense of touch when operating digital devices in North America, Europe, and Asia. It operates through two segments, Immersion and Barnes & Noble Education.
